about: L2 build fixture for public/vantage/plans.json (lane L1 owns the real file). Real shapes, our names, mirroring the carrier as seen 2026-09-30 (buying-journey brief (a) 6-9, (b)). CONTENT: the engine decides which plan leads inside 'Pair with a plan' (slot plan-pairing, 3 of 4); it never decides a price, the autopay rule or the multi-line arithmetic.
autopay: Per-line prices with autopay and paper-free billing ($10 a line off without). Taxes and fees extra.
